newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Pancon pays 40 cent/share dividend.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Pancon pays 40 cent/share dividend.

text.p: Pancontinental Mining Ltd said on Thursday that it would pay a 20 percent franked dividend of 40 cents per share as part of the distribution of proceeds from the sale of non-gold assets.

The company, which is 87.2 percent-owned by Goldfields Ltd, said the dividend had a total value of A$98 million and followed the capital reduction of A$228 million approved by shareholders at an extraordinary meeting in August.
The books closing date is November 21, with the dividend to be paid on November 27.
